description: Ribele lets authenticated creators search and review their campaigns, analyze aggregate metrics and daily trends, create new campaign drafts, and edit their fields, cover image, and primary reward or product while they remain in draft status. The reward is configured only as part of the draft: the plugin does not publish campaigns or initiate purchases, pledges, payments, refunds, or subscriptions.
